args.lesson: Bounded stop. Both cited official routes were unreachable through FETCH: the EU-Supply route hit the host redirect limit (TASK-179386380412) and the Find a Tender HTML page returned 403 (TASK-179386380413, the same as before). The structured OCDS release publishes no tender pack; its document list holds only the notice and conflictOfInterest 'Not published'. The TID parameter lacks its '=' and cannot be resolved from authoritative evidence, so I made no guess. What worked: two attempts, then extracting everything verifiable from the saved OCDS (Quality 85 / Social Value 10 / Price 5, SME and VCSE suitable, clarification deadline 2026-11-20 17:00 UTC) and turning the gaps into seven clarification questions. Next time: assume procurement portals (EU-Supply, FTS HTML) are not fetchable from this host. Use only the OCDS API, and do not open document-extraction missions for portal-hosted tender packs.
